title: Could Kylian Mbappé dictate the French Revolution?
caption: Could Kylian Mbappé dictate the French Revolution? Fast enough to storm the Bastille. Not faster than a horse. 🇫🇷⚽ #could #mbappe #frenchrevolution #napoleon #realmadrid #history #whatif #fyp

scenes.text: Could Kylian Mbappé dictate the French Revolution? {{back}}We went back to {1789|seventeen eighty nine}. ||0.2|| {{sci}}Scientifically.
Paris, {1789|seventeen eighty nine}. {{pop}}Twenty eight million French people. {{bread}}Bread costs eighty eight percent of a worker's wage. ||0.3|| {{job}}The job of leader: vacant.

The candidate: {{name}}Kylian Mbappé. {{wc}}World champion at nineteen. {{spd}}Top speed: about thirty eight kilometres per hour. {{cel}}His celebration: arms crossed. ||0.3|| {{dec}}Like a man who has already decided.
Plan A: {{t}}storm the Bastille. {{crowd}}The crowd needed most of the day. {{mb}}Mbappé needs about a minute. ||0.3|| {{pris}}He finds seven prisoners. ||0.3|| {{fans}}Seven new fans.

Plan B: {{t}}take power. {{law}}New law: every citizen celebrates with arms crossed. {{cal}}The Revolution really did invent a ten day week. ||0.3|| {{add}}Mbappé adds an eleventh. ||0.2|| {{rest}}Rest day.

One problem: {{nap}}Napoleon. ||0.3|| {{horse}}He has a horse. {{spd}}Top speed: about forty five kilometres per hour. ||0.4|| {{second}}For the first time in his life, Mbappé is the second fastest man in France.
So Mbappé has had enough of revolutions. {{go}}He goes back to his real dictatorship. {{rm}}At Real Madrid. {{q}}Who takes the penalties? ||0.4|| {{him}}He does.
Could you imagine another scenario that we should do next? {{c}}Write it in the comments.
